32AA Bra Size Guide: Measurements, Sister Sizes & Best Bras

Everything you need to know about the 32AA bra size — from how it looks to the most comfortable bra styles for your shape.

32AA at a Glance

A subtle, narrow fit on a slim frame. Lighter fabrics and wireless cuts feel best. This is a petite size. Understanding your 32AA measurements helps you choose bras that fit comfortably and flatter your figure.

Measurements

Underbust 32" (81 cm)
Bust 33" (84 cm)
Cup Volume 110 mL
Category petite

Sister Sizes

34A Looser band, same cup volume
36B Two bands up, two cups up — related size

What Does a 32AA Look Like?

[Image Placeholder: Person wearing a well-fitted 32AA bra, shown from front and side angles with a neutral, relaxed posture.]

The bust is barely there — a whisper of volume that follows the natural curve of the ribcage. Shape, not size, defines the silhouette.

To help visualize: Think of two small lemons — a subtle look on a 32-inch frame.

On a 32-inch underbust, the bust projects approximately less than 1 inch from the chest wall. Breast shape — round, teardrop, slender, or tubular — can dramatically change how 32AA looks on different bodies. Use our Breast Shape Calculator to identify your specific shape and learn how it affects fit.

Best Bra Styles for 32AA

Based on the 32AA profile, here are the bra styles we recommend for comfort, support, and a flattering silhouette:

Bralette

T-Shirt Bra

Tips for Wearing 32AA

  • Air-dry bras flat — never put bras in the dryer, as heat destroys elastic.
  • Adjust the straps each time you put a bra on — they should never be so tight that they carry the weight.
  • The band provides approximately 70% of the support — ensure it sits level all around, never riding up.
  • Breast tissue should fill the entire cup without empty space at the top or sides.
  • Sleeping in a soft wireless bra is a personal choice — no health benefit, but some prefer the comfort.
  • Moulded cups hold their shape through clothing — perfect for fitted tops and dresses.

Frequently Asked Questions

What does a 32AA look like?
A subtle, barely-there volume. Shape, not size, defines the silhouette. To visualize, think of two small lemons — a modest look that suits a 32-inch frame. Breast shape — round, teardrop, slender, or tubular — can make the same 32AA look very different from person to person. Use our Breast Shape Calculator to identify your specific shape.
What are the sister sizes of 32AA?
The sister sizes of 32AA are 34A and 36B (note: 32AA is at the edge of the cup range, so the second related size is approximate). 34A — if the band feels too tight on 32AA, try this sister size: go up one band size and down one cup size for the same approximate cup volume (110 mL) with a looser band. 36B — a related size that may also work if your usual 32AA is out of stock or the fit is close-but-not-perfect. Sister sizes share approximately the same cup volume but with different band lengths.
What type of bra is best for 32AA?
The best bra types for 32AA are: Bralette — Light, wireless comfort — ideal for smaller volumes and everyday wear; Wireless Bra — Wire-free, no-pressure fit that follows the natural shape; T-Shirt Bra — Seamless cups that disappear under fitted tops. The ideal style also depends on your breast shape and the outfits you wear. If you have a teardrop shape or concerns about support, prioritize fuller-coverage styles. For everyday versatility with 32AA, start with a well-fitted T-shirt bra and build your collection from there.
